target.title: fix: generate dashboard titles after the first message
target.body:
Closes #108183

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users starting a new Dashboard chat would see the session remain untitled after sending the first message when session bootstrap metadata had already been persisted.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Dashboard title path now uses an explicit first-turn signal captured before session bootstrap mutates system metadata. Title scheduling waits for the accepted session binding when needed, retains the pre-resolver path for plugin-handled turns, and deduplicates by session ID so reset or rotation can still title the replacement session. Existing explicit names, historical sessions, concurrent requests, and session-generation checks remain protected.

## User Impact

New Dashboard chats can receive an automatic title from their first user message again. Existing sessions are not backfilled, and manually named sessions are unchanged.

## Evidence

- Added regression coverage for a first-turn entry with `systemSent: true` and for first-turn versus existing-session binding state.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/dashboard-session-title.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/get-reply.fast-path.test.ts` — 37 tests passed.
- `pnpm tsgo:core` and `pnpm tsgo:core:test` — passed.
- Targeted oxfmt and oxlint checks — passed.
- `pnpm check:max-lines-ratchet --base upstream/main` and `git diff --check` — passed.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --stream-engine-output` — clean, no accepted or actionable findings.

No screenshot is included because this is asynchronous server-side session metadata behavior; the regression tests cover the exact first-turn bootstrap state transition.

AI-assisted: Codex helped investigate, implement, test, and review this change. I verified the final diff and validation results.
